name: kryptotome-protocol-monorepo
description: Vendor-agnostic, privacy-preserving digital entitlement and content synchronization protocol for tabletop gaming

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/sdk packages/bridge packages/vtt-adapter && node packages/sdk/scripts/copy-wasm.mjs
scripts.build:wasm: source "$HOME/.cargo/env" && cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p kryptotome-wasm --profile release-wasm && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release-wasm/kryptotome_wasm.wasm --out-dir packages/sdk/wasm --target web && npx --yes wasm-opt -Oz --enable-bulk-memory --enable-nontrapping-float-to-int packages/sdk/wasm/kryptotome_wasm_bg.wasm -o packages/sdk/wasm/kryptotome_wasm_bg.wasm
